summary: The new test is value-based, load-bearing, and correctly structured. It places funnels [fX, fA, fB] in the store with the route mock supplying funnelId:'fX', opens the dropdown via focus, and asserts on actual option DOM elements (data-test attribute per-value) — not on substring/text presence. Against pre-fix code (subscribeTargetOptions used storeFunnels.value.map without .filter), the fX option would be present in the DOM and the `toBeNull()` assertion would fail, confirming load-bearing character. Existing SUBSCRIBE tests in funnel-editor.spec.ts use a route mock without funnelId (resolves to ''), so currentFunnelId==='' matches no funnel and nothing is excluded — the pre-existing tests are unaffected and were not weakened by this change. No anti-patterns, no empty assertions, no missing coverage for this specific fix.
